name: Plume Guard
description: Spread the arms like wings over the chest and let qi harden the cloak of the sleeves.

name: Dive Shoulder
description: Fall from a short leap shoulder first onto the target with the full drop of the body.

name: Hawk Grip
description: Clamp both hands round the target's arm with a grip that does not loosen as it struggles.

name: Feather Weight
description: Lighten the stride with qi through the legs so each landing is soft and each leap is long.

name: Swoop Slip
description: Dip and glide under a blow and let it pass over the shoulder.

name: Beak Thrust
description: Stiffen two fingers with qi and drive them into a gap between plates or ribs.

name: Plumed Carapace
description: Layer qi over the whole frame in overlapping bands that turn blows like the feathers of a diving hawk.

name: Plummet Weight
description: Rise high on a gathered leap and fall with the shoulder and the whole mass of the frame.

name: Raptor Mass
description: Fall from a great height with the frame armored in qi and strike so hard that the ground and the foe both break.

name: Verdict Pressure
description: Press a flat hand against the target's chest and drive it back one step at a time.

name: Left Verdict
description: Throw the left fist at the target's guard and keep the right ready behind it.

name: Right Verdict
description: Follow the left blow with the right fist into the gap that the left opened.

name: Restraint Stance
description: Hold a calm balanced stance where the body gives only what it chooses to give.

name: Judge's Pause
description: Hold still for one breath and read the foe's stance for its weakest side.

name: Balance Weighing
description: Test the foe's balance with a light push and break it on the side that gives.

name: Mercy Mend
description: Steady a wounded ally or yourself with both hands and warm the hurt flesh into closing.

name: Strength Sentence
description: Set the weight and loose one measured blow with the full strength of the frame.

name: Paired Judgement
description: Turn aside a blow with one hand and strike through the opening with the other in a single motion.

name: Judging Weight
description: Settle the whole mass of the body onto a seized foe until it cannot rise.

name: Twin Decree
description: Deliver a blow of restraint and then a blow of strength so each lands exactly where the other prepared.

name: Upper Track
description: Send qi along the arms and shoulders and throw a blow at head height.

name: Lower Track
description: Send qi down the legs and plant them so the base cannot be swept.

name: Lane Switch
description: Cross qi from the arms to the legs in a single breath to change from strike to stride.

name: Dual Flow
description: Run qi through both tracks together so strike and guard both draw on a full supply.

name: Parallel Blows
description: Strike with both arms in parallel lines so a single guard cannot stop both.

name: Parallel Shield
description: Hold the guard high and low at once with the two tracks of qi.

name: Track Mending
description: Draw healing qi down one track while the other holds the guard and tend a hurt as you fight.

name: Azure Double
description: Strike with the upper track and brace with the lower in an unbroken pair of motions.

name: Crossed Surge
description: Cross the two tracks of qi in the chest and loose the stored strength through the next blow.

name: Dual Collapse
description: Drive both tracks into one blow so heavy that it breaks the guard and the stance behind it.

name: Source Breath
description: Breathe in the feeling of rain gathering and let qi collect low in the belly.

name: Rill Strike
description: Throw a light blow that carries only the force of the last step.

name: Rill Guard
description: Turn the forearm like a bank to send a blow along its length and off to the side.

name: Gathering Step
description: Cross the ground in even steps that gather speed as they go.

name: Stiffness Wash
description: Wash old stiffness and dull aches out of the limbs of yourself or an ally.

name: Gathering Tide
description: Collect the force of three strides into the hip and keep it ready for one blow.

name: Swollen Fist
description: Release the gathered force in a fist that lands heavier than its owner seems able to throw.

name: Bone Rapids
description: Hurl the force of a blow through the long bones and back out along the striking limb.

name: Venom Rinse
description: Rinse poison out of the blood of yourself or an ally with a steady rolling pulse of qi.

name: Flood Breaker
description: Hold the gathered force until the breath is full and break it over the target in one great blow.

name: Spate Frame
description: Swell the whole body with swollen qi so heavy strikes sink into it and spend themselves.

name: Cascade Fist
description: Pour every stored measure of force into one fist and land it so hard that it breaks stone and bone.

name: Ringing Shin
description: Meet a kick with the shin and let the bone hum with the stopped force.

name: Echo Elbow
description: Throw an elbow that rebounds off a blocked guard into a second hit.

name: Pitch Breath
description: Hum low and feel which bone of the foe or an ally is cracked or whole.

name: Resonant Bone
description: Tune the bones so a blow sets them ringing and the ring is thrown back at the striker.

name: Matching Weight
description: Answer the weight of the foe's blow with a blow of exactly the same weight.

name: Joint Quieting
description: Still the grinding of a damaged joint in yourself or an ally with a low steady pulse of qi.

name: Skeleton Chorus
description: Set every bone ringing at once so a heavy blow breaks upon the frame and returns twice as hard.

name: Bone Knell
description: Strike a fixed note into the foe's bones so they shake and its strength drains from the limbs.

name: Answering Frame
description: Take a crushing blow into the tuned frame and loose the full of it back through the striker.

name: Blood Furnace
description: Heat the blood with quick breaths until the body runs hot and strong.

name: Breath Furnace
description: Cool the body and restore its wind with slow breaths between exchanges for yourself or an ally.

name: Searing Fist
description: Throw a fist whose heat is felt before it lands.

name: Heat Sink
description: Draw the heat of a blow into the body and let it pass out through the breath.

name: Warmed Step
description: Spring off warm soles so the stride flicks forward like a spark.

name: Banked Heat
description: Store the heat of the furnace low in the belly to be drawn on in the next exchange.

name: Fever Burn
description: Raise a controlled fever in yourself or an ally to burn a taint or sickness out of the blood.

name: Furnace Mend
description: Hold a hand over a hurt and let the two furnaces warm it whole.

name: Smelting Palm
description: Press a glowing palm against armor or flesh so it softens and gives under the next blow.

name: Roaring Furnace
description: Open both furnaces fully so each blow strikes with the full heat and weight of the frame.

name: Reviving Heat
description: Pour furnace warmth into a badly hurt ally or yourself until deep wounds knit and strength returns.

name: Tempering Wave
description: Release a wave of heat from the chest that rocks the foes near you and breaks their stances.

name: Twin Blaze
description: Fire both furnaces together and loose all the stored heat through one blow that scorches and shatters.

name: Gale Lean
description: Lean the whole frame into a hard wind and let it split round you.

name: Wind Push
description: Shove both palms forward as the wind rises behind you and add its force to the push.

name: Tailwind Stride
description: Run before the wind and let it add a second pair of legs to your stride.

name: Oath Posture
description: Stand in the sworn posture and let the pledge steady the breath and fill the limbs with qi.

name: Bluster Rush
description: Rush forward in a wind-driven charge that knocks the foe's guard wide.

name: Wind Shed
description: Turn broadside to a blow and let it slide off the frame like gusts off a ridge.

name: Chill Strip
description: Strip numbing cold and creeping curse from the limbs of yourself or an ally.

name: Gale Frame
description: Hold the frame as a sworn gale of qi that blunts every blow and swells each reply.

name: Buffet Fist
description: Gather the wind into the fist and loose a punch whose gust throws back those beside the target.

name: Tempest Frame
description: Become the storm itself with the frame as its center and throw the foe off its feet with one blow.

name: Descending Stride
description: Take a long stride downhill with the weight dropping onto each foot and bounding on.

name: Extended Reach
description: Stretch the lead arm to its limit at the end of a long stride and hit with the fingertips.

name: Toe Balance
description: Hold the weight over the toes and the balance fine so that no shove can tip you.

name: Open Lung
description: Open the chest to the wide air and breathe deeply so the legs keep up their strength.

name: Breeze Sense
description: Feel the push of moving air on bare skin to sense the position of those beyond sight.

name: Gliding Drive
description: Glide the last strides to the foe with the weight low and drive the shoulder in at the end.

name: Runoff Shed
description: Tilt the guard so a blow runs off it as water runs off a slope.

name: Limb Waking
description: Rouse the stiff tired legs of yourself or an ally with long pulling strokes and warm qi.

name: Height Dive
description: Leap from a height with the stride unbroken and land the whole body upon the target.

name: Ceaseless Stride
description: Keep up the fall of the stride without a pause so the body never loses its pace.

name: Far Charge
description: Cross the whole field in a stride that ends in a blow so heavy it throws the foe from its place.

name: Open Stance
description: Stand with the arms wide and nothing hidden and let qi hold the frame firm.

name: Naked Strike
description: Throw a plain open blow from the chest with nothing held back.

name: Frank Step
description: Walk straight to the foe in full view and close the distance by honest strides.

name: Bare Breath
description: Breathe loud and slow in the open so qi spreads through the whole frame without cover.

name: Uncovered Guard
description: Meet a blow chest on with the guard dropped and the frame hardened to bear it.

name: Oath Healing
description: Speak the oath over an ally or yourself and let qi close the wounds as the words are said.

name: Frame Unwalled
description: Hold the whole frame open and unsheltered with qi packed in every limb so no blow finds a gap.

name: Fist Thunder
description: Gather the open qi into the right fist and strike once in plain sight with a crack that all can hear.

name: Frame Wrath
description: Throw open the whole frame and loose all held qi in one blow that levels the ground in front of it.

name: Bone Bearing
description: Check the line of the long bones with a breath and set them true against the push.

name: Axis Strike
description: Throw a blow straight along the bone so no force is lost at the joints.

name: Spine Column
description: Stand tall with the spine as a post and let a push run down it to the earth.

name: Straight Stride
description: Walk the leg bones in one line so the body arrives without sway.

name: Joint Alignment
description: Ease a shifted joint of yourself or an ally back onto its true line with a firm pull and warm qi.

name: Passing Force
description: Let a blow travel through the aligned bones and out the back foot into the ground.

name: Plumb Hammer
description: Bring the arm down on the plumb line of the foe's body and load it with the whole weight.

name: Marrow Clearing
description: Clear a settled taint or poison from the marrow of yourself or an ally with deep steady pulses.

name: Axis Lock
description: Catch the foe's limb on your own true line and lock it so it cannot turn.

name: Straight Pillar
description: Set the whole skeleton as a single pillar that bears any weight laid on it.

name: Bone Spear
description: Send the force of the whole skeleton down the arm and out the point of one finger.

name: Skeleton Accord
description: Align every bone to one great line and strike or turn back a blow with the full force of the frame.

name: Pledged Inhale
description: Draw a breath sworn to the wind and let it fill the muscles with held strength.

name: Gust Cuff
description: Cuff the target hard about the head with the flat of the hand as the wind rises.

name: Breath Guard
description: Hold the breath and tighten the trunk so a blow lands on a hardened drum.

name: Wind Gait
description: Move at the pace of the breath and let the wind carry you through each step.

name: Easing Exhale
description: Breathe out slowly over a hurt of yourself or an ally and feel the pain loosen.

name: Oath Lung
description: Swear aloud to endure and let qi swell the lungs to carry the oath through the fight.

name: Gale Cleanse
description: Breathe poison and foul humour out of the body of yourself or an ally in a long gale of breath.

name: Windbound Blows
description: Link four blows on four breaths so each rides the wind that the last one stirred.

name: Lung Renewal
description: Breathe a deep warm gale into the wounded body of yourself or an ally and knit its hurts.

name: Final Exhale
description: Hold the final breath of the oath and loose it all in a single blow of unmatched weight.

name: Pressure Reading
description: Feel each change in the push of air on your open frame and mark where it comes from.

name: Side Parry
description: Turn the guard against a sideways push and send the blow past on the wind.

name: Reading Strike
description: Strike at the exact point the foe's push of air has shown you.

name: Wind Weave
description: Weave between blows by stepping on the lull in the push of air.

name: Weight Answer
description: Meet a heavy blow with the matching weight in a braced frame.

name: Long Wind Breath
description: Breathe as long as the wind blows and let the strength of the breath build.

name: Gust Reply
description: Turn each gust of attack aside and answer with a swift blow on the same line.

name: Sickness Draught
description: Draw the sick wind out of the lungs of yourself or an ally and replace it with clean breath.

name: Frame Answer
description: Set the open frame against each push and return the weight of it in a heavy strike.

name: Long Wind Gale
description: Draw the wind into the frame and loose it in a roaring blow that hurls foes aside.

name: Heavy Calm
description: Stand in the heart of a storm of blows with a stillness that soaks up their strength.

name: Windshear Body
description: Slip along the line where two winds meet and strike through the foe as it falters.

name: Cyclone Mass
description: Spin the whole frame as the center of a great wind and strike all around with the weight of a falling tree.
